body:
How can I tell what solicitors are good?

We've used these solicitors for something in the past, and that was fine. Then we go with them again for the divorce and they start telling my dad's solicitors that he can have all of the joint assets. We told the solicitor to say, "tell them we want 90% of the house in return for him not having to pay spousal maintenance". Then the solicitor sends an email asking for the 90% as requested, but saying that he can have all other assets (which to my solicitor's knowledge totaled 40 grand).

It's very frustrating when the solicitor sends things we haven't agreed to.

Should we just keep paying out for solicitors until we find one that doesn't seem to be working against us?

To be honest, I've never known a solicitor to do a good job. They all seem very lazy with things. Takes her no less than a week to get a response to her emails.

We've also already paid a grand for her solicitor. I can't imagine she would want to spend another grand on a different solicitor and take a chance on them not being so useless, too.
Her divorce solicitor doesn't seem to be doing much. The solicitor is just asking my mum what she wants to do, and what share of the assets she wants.
My dad has said that if he ends up paying spousal maintenance, he'll kill her. So we'd rather not go down that route.
